facts.value: You will know that studying arts at UL might be a good fit for you if you want to choose from a wide range of subjects at an institution where you can benefit from real-world work experience and can live and study in another country; you wish to communicate your own ideas effectively and persuasively; you care about the world around you and want to understand the forces that shape people, society, culture, communication, and the physical world; you want to develop skills that will enhance your career and your contribution to society.
